version: 0.4.0
kind: ui-framework-manifest
schema_type: manifest

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.ui-framework-manifest
  name: ui-framework-manifest.schema
  description: Canonical schema for UI framework manifests.

spec:
  target_kind: ui-framework-manifest
  naming:
    file_suffix: .ui-framework.manifest.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: panes
    path: panes
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: menus
    path: menus
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: active_pane
    path: active_pane
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: pane_bindings
    path: pane_bindings
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: layout
    path: layout
    type: object
    required: false

object:
  udi: ""
  id: ""
  panes: []
  menus: []
  active_pane: ""
  pane_bindings: []
  layout: {}
